title: Randomized study to protect from radiation iatrogenic hypothyroidism patients with medulloblastoma (any stage, any biological risk) and pediatric patients with Hodgkin lymphoma and non-Hodgkin lymphoma needing radiation therapy on thyroid site - WINHYPO 2021
official: Randomized study to protect from radiation iatrogenic hypothyroidism patients with medulloblastoma (any stage, any biological risk) and pediatric patients with Hodgkin lymphoma and non-Hodgkin lymphoma needing radiation therapy on thyroid site - WINHYPO 2021
summary: Main objective: To evaluate if the incidence of hypothyroidism after radiation therapy in medulloblastoma, Hodgkin and non-Hodgkin lymphomas can be reduced by TSH suppression during irradiation.
sponsor: Fondazione IRCCS Istituto Nazionale Dei Tumori
